title: fix(approvals): name an unstaffed position by its label on the timeline; system rows read as the system's
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu9E1xEXQLqcywxKaDrDfGYv)_
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgT9mNgD8oKM93bFzg5

Fixes #35418

Clause-②: yes (widening) — @objectstack/plugin-approvals adds the optional `ApprovalServiceOptions.positionLabelSource`; @object-ui/i18n adds approvalsInbox.systemActor and approvalsInbox.actSystemNote; nothing removed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批动态里「转交给管理员」那条说明不再出现内部岗位名：中文读者看到「岗位「销售经理」无人任职」，没有翻译时用岗位自己的显示名，都没有才退回内部名。
- 系统自动写的条目（转交说明、排除提交人、无人可审、自动撤销等）操作人显示「系统」，说明类条目类型显示「系统说明」，不再是「评论 · —」；真人评论照旧是「评论 · 某人」。
- 属于「控制台核心业务操作体验」专题；只改显示，库里存的审计原文、转交规则都不动，出问题可直接撤回。
- 已知没做：「无人可审」说明里的「担任 position 'x' 的成员」也带内部岗位名（存的是拼好的整句），列为后续，不在本 PR。

## What changes

1. **The routing note names a position by its label.** `admin-rescue-note.ts`: `adminRescueNoteText(note, render, positionLabel?)` maps each unheld-position clause's `value` through `positionLabel` before rendering; `adminRescuePositions` lists the note's position names. `ApprovalService.localizeRoutingNotes` builds the map per read (`notePositionLabels`): the reader's pack `positions.<name>.label` (new `ReaderLabels.positionLabel`, key spelled by `positionLabelKey` beside the flow keys), else the declared `label` from the new optional `ApprovalServiceOptions.positionLabelSource`, else nothing (the name stands). `ApprovalsServicePlugin` wires that source to the `metadata` service's `get('position', name)`, resolved lazily like the i18n source. A throwing source is caught: the read never fails on a label. The row's stored English `comment` (the audit text, and what a read with no locale is served) is unchanged and keeps the name.
2. **The timeline names the platform's rows.** `ApprovalActionTimeline.tsx`: a row with no `actor_id` reads its actor as `approvalsInbox.systemActor` ("System" / 系统) instead of "—"; a `comment` row with no actor (`isSystemNote`, new `utils/approvalSystemNote.ts`) reads its kind as `approvalsInbox.actSystemNote` ("System note" / 系统说明) instead of "Commented". `system:sla` keeps "System (SLA)". New keys in all eleven packs, translated.
3. **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, "When a slate names no one": the stored note keeps the English with the position's name; a reader is served it in their language with the position's label, shown as a system note (the Docs Drift Check listed this page).

The card allowed 「转交」 or 「系统」 for the kind. The three no-actor comment notes are not all hand-offs (admin routing, submitter exclusion, no approver), and telling them apart on the client would need a new field on the actions contract, so they share "System note" and the sentence itself says what happened. This reading was stated in the claim.

## Tests

<details><summary>Approvals plugin</summary>

- `admin-rescue-note.test.ts`: a position clause takes the label it is given and only a position does (team literal and an unknown position keep their names); a clause the pack lacks falls back to English with the label; the stored English keeps the name; `adminRescuePositions` dedupes and skips non-position and empty slots.
- `reader-locale-labels.test.ts`: `positionLabelKey` spelling, held to `TranslationDataSchema` by the existing round trip; the pick reads `positions.<name>.label` in the negotiated locale.
- `admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts`, new describe `[#35418] the note names an unheld position by its label` (real in-memory i18n with the plugin's catalog plus an app pack): zh-CN reads 「岗位「销售经理」无人任职」 and no `sales_manager`; en reads the declared label "position 'Sales Manager' has no holder"; ja-JP with no translation reads the declared label; CONTROL the stored row and a no-locale read keep the name; a throwing source keeps the name and does not fail the read.
- Run: those three files 45 passed; `approval-service.test.ts` + `submitter-exclusion-note.test.ts` 486 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Console and i18n</summary>

- `ApprovalActionTimeline.systemNote-35418.test.tsx`: en "System note · System" with no "Commented" and no "—"; a person's comment keeps "Commented · Bob" (live control in the same DOM); a no-actor `cancel` row names "System"; zh 「系统说明 · 系统」 and 「评论 · Bob」. 3 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` (includes all-locale key parity): 105 files passed, 1957 passed, 13 skipped.
- eslint over the changed files: 0 errors (one pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warning in `ApprovalActionTimeline.tsx`, not on a changed line).
</details>

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)

- The no-approver note's `{{who}}` ("…a member who holds position 'crm_sales_manager'…") is stored pre-composed (`noApproverWho`), so it still names the machine name; labelling it means storing the slots instead of the joined string.

## Verification

Read first: `admin-rescue-note.ts` (`labelledPosition`), `ApprovalService.localizeRoutingNotes` and `notePositionLabels`, the `positionLabelSource` wiring in `approvals-plugin.ts`, `ApprovalActionTimeline.tsx` (`actionText`, `actorName`).

Two-minute check: `cd packages/plugins/plugin-approvals && pnpm exec vitest run src/admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts`; expect the `[#35418]` describe green.

<details><summary>Local gates at 064e714d</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 109 derived families accounted for, 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (all with exit 0; the 28 families the docs commit added were run on 064e714d, the other 81 on cfacf209, which differs from it only by that docs page). Four first answered on a shallow, partly built clone and were rerun after the prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (pinned fixture commit fetched), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (needed the `@objectstack/client` dist; then 172 files passed, 2 skipped), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (after a full `pnpm build`). `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: clean against origin/main 9b3227fe and 4 open PRs sharing the locale packs or `approval-service.ts` (#36018, #35994, #35969, #35968). CI families: not yet reported at open.
</details>
